acceptanceCriteria.text: Game-window Record starts and stops UI and engine capture together with API capture
Interaction records persist in chrome.storage.local with timestamps and bounded payloads
Game-window export includes correlated interaction and API records
Capture does not alter game behavior or record typed input values

checkpointPayload.description: Use the game-window Record control to capture DOM/canvas actions and exposed Unity method calls, persist locally, and export a correlated analysis log.
checkpointPayload.title: Record game UI interactions and exposed engine calls alongside API capture

taskChanges.newValue:
1. Reuse current game-window Record control and background recording queue; store bounded interaction entries in chrome.storage.local.
2. Capture safe DOM/canvas pointer and key metadata in bridge, and observable Unity SendMessage calls in page context.
3. Export a combined timeline from game-window export control while retaining existing API-only popup export.
4. Add targeted tests, run project check/build, and validate task.
